description.value:
You are more than a simple machine. You gain the Construct Tag and can not gain the Ki Control Heroic Feature through Training or Level Up.

Additionally you begin with the Arm Missle Technique and it's Ki Rank is equal to your own.

Arm Missile

Rank ? Melee Technique

  • Casting Time: 1 action
  • Range: 120 feet
  • Chargeable?: Yes
  • Duration: Instantaneous

Fire your forearm off like a rocket before it returns and replaces itself on your arm. Make a combo attack roll against a target in range dealing your unarmed damage die + Xd4 Force Damage where X is your Proficiency Bonus.
